entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I was wondering if we could get[n]something outta Takamaki.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You know how we didn't get a[n]thing outta the volleyball team?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I figured it'd be a good idea to[n]talk to someone who knows them.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Takamaki's BFFs with a starter.[n]A girl named Suzui.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I tried to talk to that girl[n]during break, but I got nothing.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's why we should have[n]Takamaki talk to her.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then again, I guess it'll be[n]hard getting her to help us...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry. Lemme see what else[n]I can come up with.
